P7 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
The genome is not filtered for response, so most of these 13,756 genes carry no
signal at all. That makes the per-gene noise floor WORSE than on loop 198's 600
responders and cuts against the noise-limited hypothesis, which is stated here so a
flat P5 cannot later be blamed on it.
k-means on 8-dimensional trajectories is a coarse clustering and k=300 is a choice,
not a measurement. P2 checks it reproduces loop 219's linkage result on the 600 but
does not establish it is the right k at genome scale.
If P5 fails and P6 passes, the artefact is identified but not explained -- naming a
shared component is not the same as knowing whether it is a batch, a flowcell or a
genuine biological difference between the cultures.
ENCODE does not publish per-replicate batch metadata for this series, so the
hypothesis cannot be confirmed against the experimental record from here.
